title: Hidden code in ChatGPT’s Android app suggests OpenAI is building a direct WhatsApp sticker export
excerpt: An APK teardown found code for an "Add to WhatsApp" option in ChatGPT that would let users generate stickers from text prompts and export them directly. Not yet live.
content_html:
TL;DR

APK teardown reveals ChatGPT may soon let users generate stickers and export them directly to WhatsApp via an “Add to WhatsApp” button. Not announced by OpenAI. Not live yet.

Hidden code in ChatGPT’s latest Android app suggests OpenAI is building a feature that would let users generate stickers and export them directly to WhatsApp. An APK teardown by Android Authority found references to an “Add to WhatsApp” option in the sharing menu. Instead of sending AI-generated images as regular pictures, ChatGPT would prepare them in WhatsApp’s sticker format before handing them off to the messaging app.

The workflow would replace a multi-step process. Today, creating a custom WhatsApp sticker from ChatGPT requires generating an image, removing its background, saving it locally, and importing it into a third-party sticker tool. The teardown suggests OpenAI is building the conversion directly into ChatGPT, turning a text prompt into a WhatsApp sticker in a few taps. Users could create personalised reaction stickers, memes, or illustrations from a single prompt.

The feature reflects how ChatGPT’s image generation has moved from novelty to daily utility. OpenAI just removed usage limits for free ChatGPT users, and image generation was already one of the most popular features after the viral Ghibli-style and action figure trends earlier this year. Making those images directly shareable inside the world’s most popular messaging app, WhatsApp has more than two billion users, would remove the friction that currently stops most people from turning AI images into stickers.

OpenAI has not announced the feature, and APK teardowns surface code that may never ship. But the integration makes strategic sense. ChatGPT is increasingly competing not just with other chatbots but with the creative tools people use daily. A native WhatsApp sticker pipeline would make ChatGPT harder to replace for the hundreds of millions of users who already generate images inside it. Whether it launches is uncertain. That OpenAI is building the plumbing is not.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

APK 拆解显示 ChatGPT 可能很快就会让用户生成贴纸并通过“添加到 WhatsApp”按钮将其直接导出到 WhatsApp。 OpenAI 尚未宣布。 还没活呢。

ChatGPT 最新 Android 应用程序中的隐藏代码表明 OpenAI 正在构建一项功能，允许用户生成贴纸并将其直接导出到 WhatsApp。 Android Authority 的 APK 拆解发现，共享菜单中引用了“添加到 WhatsApp”选项。 ChatGPT 不会将人工智能生成的图像作为普通图片发送，而是将其准备为 WhatsApp 的贴纸格式，然后再将其传递给消息应用程序。

工作流程将取代多步骤流程。 如今，从 ChatGPT 创建自定义 WhatsApp 贴纸需要生成图像、删除背景、保存在本地，然后将其导入第三方贴纸工具。 拆解表明 OpenAI 正在将转换直接构建到 ChatGPT 中，只需点击几下即可将文本提示转换为 WhatsApp 贴纸。 用户可以根据单个提示创建个性化反应贴纸、模因或插图。

该功能反映了 ChatGPT 的图像生成如何从新颖性转变为日常实用性。 OpenAI 刚刚取消了免费 ChatGPT 用户的使用限制，继今年早些时候病毒式的吉卜力风格和动作人物趋势之后，图像生成已经成为最受欢迎的功能之一。 让这些图像直接在拥有超过 20 亿用户的世界上最受欢迎的消息应用程序 WhatsApp 中共享，将消除目前阻止大多数人将人工智能图像变成贴纸的障碍。

OpenAI 尚未宣布该功能，并且 APK 拆解了可能永远不会发布的表面代码。 但整合具有战略意义。 ChatGPT 不仅与其他聊天机器人竞争，还与人们日常使用的创意工具竞争。 对于已经在其中生成图像的数亿用户来说，原生 WhatsApp 贴纸管道将使 ChatGPT 更难被取代。 是否推出尚不确定。 OpenAI 正在构建管道，但事实并非如此。
